long_description:
Click builds useful services that meet users right inside ChatGPT and Claude.
We're starting with a research service that provides external context that the built-in web search misses - like data from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. 
It makes research on people & companies even deeper with specialized, source-backed context beyond built-in web search, while enabling new tasks like comparing live flight fares right inside the chat.
name: Click
one_liner: Research services for ChatGPT and Claude
